meta.name: Shock
meta.description:
This post-World War II suspense thriller sets off an emotional roller coaster after the psychologically fragile wife of a POW (Anabel Shaw) witnesses a brutal murder from a hotel window while waiting to be reunited with her husband (Frank Latimer).
By the time he arrives, she's nearly comatose with shock. 
The hotel's psychiatrist (Vincent Price) is called in to help

Film noir classic, noted for its dark themes, stark camera angles and high-contrast lighting.
